# Coherent count component and finite-sample screen

Test-only alternative: total Dirichlet mass2, uniform full inputs, binary
outcome symmetry. Aggregate full-cell masses to all3^9 partial states. No
parameter sweep. Root forecast matches old Beta(1,1), fine masks intentionally
do not. Literal enumeration and every parent-child identity must hold.

Finite quality screen:192 independent fits, two input laws (uniform/copybit2to0),
two targets(bit2/paritybits1..4), n64/128/4096,16 fits per cell. Noise.05.
Seed2026092170+dep*1000000+target*100000+n*20+index. Exact expected Brier over
512raw inputs at masks0,1,31,511. Same samples in both estimators. No selected
mask, current-label input, oracle fitted weight, adaptive path or task result.

Purpose: distinguish mathematical coherence from predictive benefit. Retain
all masks and regressions; do not promote from a favorable mask. Finite
component comparison, no new whole-goal gate. Benchmark fit separately from
quality collection; neither proves daemon latency. Original estimator untouched.
sources.docs/experiments/mmm-coherent-count-stre:
# Frozen high-noise and null-label stress

Unchanged coherent-count total prior mass2. Same old-count control, same four
fixed masks0/1/31/511 and input/target families as the low-noise screen.
Two noise levels .25 and .5; .5 is outcome independent of all fields.
16 independent fits per cell at n64/128/4096;384fits total. Seed
2026092180+noiseIndex*10000000+dep*1000000+target*100000+n*20+index.
Exact finite-population risk. No prior-strength sweep, retrospective mask
selection, adaptive observer, fresh confirmation claim or changed goal gate.
The purpose is to identify overfitting before promoting a coherent component.

limits: Fixed-mask finite-population diagnostic, descriptive paired mean +/-3.5SE over training fits; no adaptive or real-task benefit established.
